senses.gloss: भक्ति- + छेद भक्ति- + छेद, m. certain streaks on the forehead, nose, cheeks, breast, and arms, which denote a follower of Viṣṇu.
भक्त- + दास भक्त- + दास (vb. [] भज्), m. a slave maintained in consideration of service, Man. 8, 415.

भक्त भक्त, i. e. ptcple. pf. pass. of भज् (in the signification To cook, cf. also भक्ष्), n.
 1. Food, Man. 9, 271.
 2. Boiled rice.
 3. A meal, Man. 11, 16.
 --Comp.

भक्ति भक्ति, i. e. भज् and भञ्ज् + ति,
 1. Worship, Vikr. d. 1; service.
 2. Devotion, Hit. iii. d. 65.
 3. Attachment, Pañc. i. d. 326.
 4. Faith, Pañc. 71, 4; belief, Śāṇḍilyas. ed. Ballantyne, 76 sqq.
 5. Fracture, breaking, Megh. 61.
 6. In भक्ति-छेद, Megh. 19, see छेद.
 --Comp.
भक्तिभाज् भक्तिभाज्, i. e. भक्ति-भज्, adj. Devout, Pañc. 236, 20.
भक्तिमन्त् भक्ति + मन्त्, adj., f. ती, Devoted, faithful, Pañc. pr. d. 5.

भक्ष् भक्ष्, akin to भज् and भञ्ज्, i. 1, Par. Ātm., and i. 10, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm.),
 1. To devour, Man. 5, 50.
 2. To eat, MBh. 3, 1741.
 3. To enjoy, Pañc. 137, 20.
 4. To bite, Pañc. 62, 23; Kathās. 4, 69.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass. भक्ष्य, Eatable, allowed to be eaten, Man. 1, 113. n.
 1. Food, Pañc. 199, 13.
 2. Dainty food, Man. 9, 268; 3, 227.
 --Comp.
 --With [] सम् सम्, To devour, MBh. 3, 422.
 --Cf. ϕαγεῖν, perhaps ϕακός, ϕάσηλος; Lat. fames, perhaps bacca.

भक्ष भक्ष् + अ,
 I. m., f. षा, and n. (Pañc. rec. orn.), Eating food, Pañc. 53, 23.
 II. latter part of comp. adj. Devouring, Man. 9, 314 v. r.
 --Comp.

भक्षक भक्ष् + अक,
 I. adj.
 1. Voracious.
 2. Eating, feeding on, Hit. 75, 8.
 3. A feeder, Hit. i. d. 54, M.M.
 II. f. षिका, A meal.

भक्षण भक्षण, i. e. भक्ष् + अन, n.
 1. Eating, Pañc. 114, 10; being eaten, 88, 25.
 2. Enjoying, Vedāntas. in Chr. 219, 4.
 --Comp.
ऽभक्षिन् -भक्ष् + इन्, adj. Eating; in सर्व-, adj. Eating all kinds of food, Pañc. i. d. 472.
भक्ति- + योग भक्ति- + योग, m. devotion, as shown by implicit faith in any divinity.
भक्ष- + स्थान भक्ष- + स्थान, n. state of being (one's) food, Pañc. 131, 2 (भक्षस्थाने स्थितम् अपि, although you are destined to be his food).
